text_block_list.text: One evening, while passing through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, you know what,
Onii-sama?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, you know what,
Onee-sama?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-Here, you can hab dis ticket!
I received a sheet of paper from a trembling, nervous Rice Shower.
That piece of paper was—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara-chan taught me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They said they're holding a "New Autumn Lottery Draw!"
down at the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I heard the grand prize is an extravagant prize!
So... you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I thought you might want to try it too, Big Brother.
So Rice got it ready."
choice_data_list: ...Well then, shall we give it a try together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe Big Sister would like to try it too.
So Rice got it ready.
choice_data_list: ...Well then, shall we give it a try together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way! If Rice is there,
we'll never win the prize—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawawa... Big Brother!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawawa... Big Sister!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's the spirit!
Well then, give it a shot right now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Is it really okay... for Rice to do it too?
And praying together, the two of them grasped the lever and turned the raffle drum.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yay, yay!
Congratulations, Onii-sama!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yay, yay!
Congratulations, Onee-sama!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you shouldn't be congratulating Rice.
After all, you're the one who won it, Big Brother.
choice_data_list: Still, Rice pulled along with me, right?
Still, Rice pulled along with me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you shouldn't be congratulating Rice.
After all, you're the one who won it, Big Sister.
choice_data_list: Still, Rice pulled along with me, right?
Still, Rice pulled along with me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: So this grand prize belongs to both of us!

text_block_list.text:
And Rice Shower should also have
the right to receive this grand prize.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it really okay
for Rice to have some too?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... in that case,
um... you know!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Could we maybe... use it together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Since it's something the two of us won together...
I was thinking I'd like us to... enjoy the trip together too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah, really?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once we finish everything we want to do
and feel like relaxing,
let's go together! Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once we finish everything we want to do
and feel like relaxing,
let's go together! Big Sister!

"And with the 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket' in hand,
I promised Rice Shower that we would go
together one day."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-First place!? Onii-sama, you're amazing!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because I drew it together with Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-First place!? Onee-sama, you're amazing!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because I drew it together with Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. That's not... true at all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Here you go, you two! Your prize!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... That looks so delicious...
Just looking at it makes my mouth—
(Uuuugh~~~~...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hawawa, tummy!? Why're you rumbling right now!?
choice_data_list: Let's hurry home and get something to eat

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, yes.
With all the joy and surprise, it's no wonder she ended up so hungry.

The two of them thoroughly enjoyed the
'Special Carrot Hamburg Steak' they had obtained.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Incredible... I can't believe something like this happened...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Big Brother!
There are so many carrots!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Big Sister!
There are so many carrots!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I get it!
With this much food,
it'd be tough to finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh, well...
Uuu~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother, can you eat
sweets made by Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Big Sis, can you eat
the sweets Rice made?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! Rice will make looooots for you!

Later on, the two of us enjoyed
the carrot cookies that Rice Shower had baked.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, it's not a dud!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, you're not a dud!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Wow, things like this really happen. I just assumed I'd lose out like always.

It was only 3rd prize, but a win is a win.
I gave the prize carrot to Rice Shower
as a memento of today.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It really was Rice's fault~.
I'm so sorry, Onii-sama~.
choice_data_list: Still, it's really appreciated around this time of year!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It really was Rice's fault~.
I'm so sorry, Onee-sama~.
choice_data_list: Still, it's really appreciated around this time of year!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But still, but still, I really wanted you to win a good prize... *sniff*

"...And so, for Rice Shower's teary eyes,
I immediately put the very first tissue to use."
